sloka: हनुमांस्तु गुरून् वृद्धान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्तदा ।कुमारमङ्गदं चैव सो ऽवन्दत महाकपिः ।। 5.57.34 ।।।।
transliteration: hanumāṁstu gurūn vṛddhān jāmbavatpramukhāṁstadā ।kumāramaṅgadaṁ caiva so 'vandata mahākapiḥ ।। 5.57.34 ।।।।

translations.english: The great Hanuman also offered salutations to elders, preceptors such as Jambavan and other leaders. He also saluted the young Angada.
